attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used by every render in every tenant is changed to a per-manager global lock (ILocalLock keyed by type name, not per-theme) which could serialize shape table builds across all themes/tenants and introduce subtle regressions if ILocalLock isn't properly registered in all hosting scenarios or if the lock scope causes contention under high concurrency."}

reason: Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used by every render in every tenant is changed to a per-manager global lock (ILocalLock keyed by type name, not per-theme) which could serialize shape table builds across all themes/tenants and introduce subtle regressions if ILocalLock isn't properly registered in all hosting scenarios or if the lock scope causes contention under high concurrency.
